title: Answers to your top 5 TMS questions
description: If you have more questions, reach out for a direct answer.

primary.textDescription: Call us with your TMS questions

items.title: Does TMS hurt?
items.content: You will feel a tapping sensation on your scalp during the session. Most patients find it tolerable, and any discomfort typically fades within the first few treatments.

items.title: How long does a single TMS session take?
items.content: Each session lasts about 20 minutes. You sit in a chair and a magnetic coil is placed against your head. You can drive yourself home afterward.

items.title: How many sessions will I need?
items.content: A standard course is 36 sessions, typically once daily, five days a week. Your clinician will create a schedule that fits your needs and monitor progress throughout.

items.title: Will TMS interfere with my medications?
items.content: TMS is often used alongside medication. It does not interact with most drugs, but we review your full history during the initial assessment to make sure it is a safe fit.

items.title: Does insurance cover TMS?
items.content: Many major insurers cover TMS for treatment-resistant depression. Our team can verify your benefits before you start and walk you through any out-of-pocket costs.
